name: ChartData
description: Represents access to the linked or embedded data associated with a chart.
remarks: Use the ChartData property to return the ChartData object.

properties.name: Workbook
properties.description: Returns the workbook that contains the chart data associated with the chart. Read-only Object.

properties.name: IsLinked
properties.description: True if the data for the chart is linked to an external Microsoft Excel workbook. Read-only Boolean.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates the first window of the workbook associated with the chart.

methods.name: BreakLink
methods.description: Removes the link between the data for a chart and a Microsoft Excel workbook.

methods.name: ActivateChartDataWindow
methods.description: Opens a Excel data grid window that contains the full source data for the specified chart.
